about.title: About Us | Atlanta Bounce House Rental Directory
about.desc: Learn about the Atlanta Bounce House Rental Directory and how we connect Atlanta families and event planners with trusted bounce house and party rental providers across Georgia.
about.body:
Atlanta Bounce House Rentals is an independent online directory that helps families, schools, churches, businesses and event planners across Atlanta, Georgia find and compare local bounce house and party rental providers in one convenient place.

Our Mission

Planning a party should be fun, not frustrating. Our mission is to make it simple to discover reputable rental companies in the Atlanta metro, compare the services they offer and request free quotes, all without spending hours searching across dozens of websites and phone calls.

What We Do

We maintain an organized directory of bounce house and party rental services available throughout Atlanta and surrounding communities, including classic bounce houses, bounce-and-slide combos, water slides, obstacle courses, concessions, tents, tables and chairs, interactive games, full party packages and event staffing.

When you submit a quote request, we connect you with providers in our network who serve your area and offer the rentals you need. We do not own the inflatables ourselves; instead, we focus on connecting customers with the right local companies.

Why Use a Directory?

  • Save time: Compare multiple Atlanta providers from a single request.
  • Transparent pricing: See typical small, medium and large event price ranges before you book.
  • Local focus: Every provider serves the Atlanta, Georgia metro area.
  • No obligation: Quotes are always free and you choose who to book.

Serving the Atlanta Metro

Our directory covers Atlanta and surrounding communities including Buckhead, Midtown, Decatur, Sandy Springs, Marietta, Roswell, Alpharetta, Smyrna, East Point, College Park, Dunwoody and more.

Get in Touch

Questions, feedback, or interested in joining the directory as a provider? Visit our Contact page or call (401) 889-0182.

privacy-policy.title: Privacy Policy | Atlanta Bounce House Rental Directory
privacy-policy.desc: Privacy Policy for Atlanta Bounce House Rentals, covering how we collect and use information, cookies, third-party advertising including Google AdSense, and your choices.
privacy-policy.body:
Last updated: June 1, 2026

This Privacy Policy explains how Atlanta Bounce House Rentals ("we," "us," or "our") collects, uses, and protects information when you visit atlbouncehouserentals.com (the "Site"). By using the Site, you agree to the practices described below.

Information We Collect

  • Information you provide: When you submit a quote or contact form, we collect details such as your name, phone number, email address, event date, ZIP code and message.
  • Automatically collected information: Like most websites, we and our service providers collect information such as your IP address, browser type, device information, pages visited and referring URLs through cookies and similar technologies.

How We Use Information

  • To connect you with rental providers in our directory that match your request.
  • To respond to inquiries and provide customer support.
  • To operate, maintain and improve the Site.
  • To analyze traffic and usage trends.
  • To comply with legal obligations.

How We Share Information

We may share the information you submit through a quote request with rental providers in our network so they can contact you about your event. We do not sell your personal information. We may share information with service providers who help us operate the Site, or when required by law.

Cookies and Similar Technologies

We use cookies and similar technologies to remember preferences, understand how the Site is used, and serve relevant advertising. You can control cookies through your browser settings; disabling cookies may affect Site functionality.

Third-Party Advertising and Google AdSense

We use third-party advertising companies, including Google, to serve ads when you visit the Site.

  • Third-party vendors, including Google, use cookies to serve ads based on your prior visits to this and other websites.
  • Google's use of advertising cookies enables it and its partners to serve ads to you based on your visit to our Site and/or other sites on the Internet.
  • You may opt out of personalized advertising by visiting Google Ads Settings.
  • You may also opt out of some third-party vendors' use of cookies for personalized advertising by visiting aboutads.info or the NAI opt-out page.

For more information on how Google uses data, see How Google uses information from sites or apps that use our services.

Analytics

We may use analytics services to understand how visitors interact with the Site. These services may collect information sent by your browser as part of a web page request, including cookies and your IP address.

Children's Privacy

The Site is intended for adults planning events. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you believe a child has provided us information, please contact us so we can remove it.

Your Choices and Rights

You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of the personal information you have submitted by contacting us. Depending on your location, you may have additional rights under applicable privacy laws.

Data Security

We take reasonable measures to protect the information we collect. However, no method of transmission or storage is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Changes will be posted on this page with an updated revision date.

Contact Us

If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, contact us at hello@atlbouncehouserentals.com or call (401) 889-0182.
